::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 24th 1875  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin.
:::

My dear [Mr Graves](people/person_577.qmd)

I am afraid I must not take Second Fiddles though I am much obliged to you for it.  We are changing our printing house, and I want to have only matters of necessity on my hands just now.<sup>1</sup>

[Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd) is going to send me a photograph of [Bp Patteson](people/person_1155.qmd)’s sculpture.  I hope we shall have it in the next [edition](cmy_books/cmybook_102.qmd).

yours sincerely
C M Yonge
